text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important area is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in what we write. NLP is also used for translation, so tools like Google Translate can change text from one language into another. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where computers study words to discover if a message is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, our daily life with technology is becoming easier and more helpful.
